notes.title: Multiplicity v3.57 is Now Available
notes.content:
[h1]Multiplicity gets new update![/h1]
Instantly connect up to 2+ PCs and control them with a single keyboard and mouse, copy/paste formatted text and images, send data easily between computers, and more. If you work between multiple computers to play, work, and create, Multiplicity is the tool you need to get more done.

[h2]v3.57 is a culmination of 2 revisions[/h2]
[h3]Official Changelog:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Passcode for audio will be hidden by default when settings are locked.
[*] Changes to the keyboard handling queue to further prevent the possibility it could stall things
[/list]

notes.title: Multiplicity v3.5 adds major improvements and implements user feedback
notes.content:
[h1]Multiplicity v3.5 is Now Available[/h1]
[h2]Instantly connect multiple PCs with this versatile, secure, and affordable KM software solution[/h2]

Multiplicity is the best wireless KM/KVM software solution around and makes working on multiple computers a breeze! Control multiple machines using a single keyboard and mouse, move files between them easily, and avoid all the hassles of wires and hardware costs for a traditional hardware switch. 

[h2]We’ve been listening to user feedback and have implemented the following improvements in v3.5:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Adds a flush DNS entry to the right-click menu (for when your computer has changed IP and the OS doesn't know as it has cached it)
[*] Adds a message about disabling the cloud clipboard sharing in the OS if detected once
[*] Adds text about the VirtualBox network adapter breaking WakeOnLan
[*] Tweaks how it handles cursors if PCs are under heavy load
[*] Modifies how it polls for certain events which might make it more friendly to machines with huge numbers of CPU cores rather than potentially keeping them awake
[*] Swaps the mouse buttons, if you have swap mouse buttons enabled, so it doesn't double swap.
[*] Should address the issue with cursor shrinking in mixed dpi setups
[*] Fixed issue with Drag and Drop that could have it not work consistently if Primary had a higher DPI scale than the destination Secondary
[*] Fixed an issue where the Primary setting 'Prevent secondary computers auto sleeping whilst using this computer' would not work.
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30381023/c7e5c4da66220be13e1f306a4a57e5d64a08cd7b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30381023/2fcc5dbc0e062935bb57d20d3efeef894cae3be8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30381023/27ace1a9c32e45c8f989ecabac03c85aa7f15f77.png[/img]

notes.title: Groupy is Now Available on Steam
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28974/f68e9780708918a0e9818f40ce16fd123b0cba3f.jpg[/img]

[b]Get what you’ve always wanted from Windows: browser-like tabs for your apps![/b]

Keep all your apps together in browser-like tabs with Groupy! This app will transform the way you use your PC. A popular utility app from the makers of Fences and Multiplicity, Groupy lets Windows users group desktop windows together as easily as browsers group websites together.

Groupy is a killer app that will let you take things like Microsoft Office programs, Adobe Creative Suite apps, File Explorer windows, and much more, and put them into tabbed groups. Just like modern web browsers group their websites together, you can now do that with all of the Windows apps on your desktop, making for a cleaner and more efficient experience.

Creating groups is simple: drag a window to another window and combine them into a single window, with tabs showing in the title bar. For example, open multiple web browsers, all in one set of tabs, or Office applications like Excel and Word, all in a single, easy-to-use window.
To ungroup, simply drag the tab off the group. Save existing groups and launch them at a later time, contained and ready to go. 

Once a group is created, you can quickly switch between different windows with a simple hot-key or by clicking on the tab. Groupy can also automatically add launched programs into an existing tabbed group. 

Groupy works on Windows 10, 8, and 7.  

[b]Features: [/b]
[list]
[*][b]Drag and drop[/b] applications together to group them under a common tabbed interface
[*][b]Organize[/b] multiple applications and documents together for convenient access
[*][b]Group[/b] related tabs together for optimal workflow
[*][b]Save groups[/b] of applications together for future usage
[*][b]Manage tabs[/b] in quick and natural ways with the browser-like interface
[*][b]Add new tabs[/b] to existing groups quickly and easily
[*][b]Mouseover[/b] tabs to preview the window contents
[/list]
